description: Pushes a week of strength guides: one NEW SuuntoPlus guide per date, each built and sent exactly like push_strength_guide (same arguments per guide, without guideId; several dates coexist on the account). dryRun defaults to TRUE: then it only validates every guide (schema, unique dates, building each guide) and returns what it would push as { dryRun: true, ok, wouldPush: [{ date, title, exercises, sets }], notes } without contacting Suunto; show that to the user and call again with dryRun: false only when they agree. With dryRun false: everything is validated and built first, then the guides are pushed one after the other in date order (queued with a short pause, each read back from the guide list); the first failure stops the push, so the result is { dryRun: false, ok, pushed: [{ date, title, id, check: { verified, note? } }], failed?: { date, error }, notPushed?: [dates], notes } (ok false with failed set; say which days are missing). Pushing the same plan twice creates duplicates (list_guides / delete_guide to tidy up); to overwrite one guide use push_strength_guide with guideId. At most 14 guides. Requires SUUNTO_APP_NAME for a real push. Same delivery caveat as push_strength_guide: it appears after the phone's next normal Suunto app sync. Write operation (dryRun false).

dryRun.description: true (default): validate only and return what would be pushed; false: push the guides.

guides.description: One strength guide spec per date (dates must differ).

detail.description: Display string shown on the exercise's set steps, and on the prep screen before it unless 'plates' is given — include weight and sets, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

last.description: Optional: what was done last time, e.g. '3x8@60kg' (get_exercise_history's suggestion.last). Shown with target in a 'TODAY' popup when the exercise's prep step starts, never in the step text, so lap labels are unchanged. The hint 'Last <last> > <target>' must fit 36 characters: when it does not, last is shortened to its top reps ('10/10/10/10/8@102.5kg' becomes '10@102.5kg'), then dropped so the target stays whole, and if even that does not fit there is no popup (a number is never cut). Not yet verified on a real watch how the popup renders.

plates.description: Per-side plate breakdown for barbell exercises, e.g. '2x20+1x5/side' — shown on the prep screen instead of detail, since that's when the bar actually gets loaded. Omit for non-barbell exercises (dumbbell, machine, bodyweight, cable); compute the math yourself before calling this tool, it isn't done here.

restSec.description: Rest between sets within this exercise, in seconds. With restMode 'countdown' (default) it's the countdown and auto-advance duration; with 'stopwatch' it's shown as a target label only. Not applied between exercises — that's the self-paced prep stopwatch.

restTargetHr.description: Optional target heart rate to recover to during this exercise's rests between sets, in bpm (41-200). Adds a gauge from 40 to this value right after the live HR on every rest step of this exercise (both restModes); it is a visual target only and does not end the rest. Not shown on prep or set steps. Omit for no gauge.

sets.description: Number of sets for this exercise.

target.description: Optional: today's target, e.g. '3x8@62.5kg' (get_exercise_history's suggestion.target). See last.

lapGranularity.description: 'perSet' (default, recommended): one step per set plus one per rest, so laps bound every set/rest individually — needed to read per-set HR and duration from the synced workout. 'perExercise': one step per whole exercise instead, like push_workout_guide — shorter Guide list, coarser data.

restMode.description: Rest between sets. 'countdown' (default): counts down from restSec and auto-advances into the next set. 'stopwatch': counts up and waits for a lap press — the user paces it. Has no effect with lapGranularity 'perExercise' (no between-set rests). Before/between exercises is always a self-paced stopwatch.

title.description: Short session name shown in the Suunto app, e.g. 'Push A'.

name: push_week_plan
title: Push a week of strength guides to the watch (dry run by default)
